title: The hub run: pack, carry, hand over, bring back
purpose: Every phone reaches the hub tonight and comes back empty, signed at every handover.
owner: The runner, under the Planning and Logistics Lead
with: the Portfolio Manager, hub attendant, and operator
when: Every night after the end-of-day review, and before 7:00 AM.
takes: Three sites tonight, then the same three in the morning.
needs: The provided bag, with a phone list inside

steps.do: Get tonight's run and check the letter kit.
steps.detail: Your three sites and your hub from the Planning and Logistics Lead. No letter, no run.

steps.do: Pack and sign with the Portfolio Manager.
steps.detail: All the site's phones, by device number, against the phone list.
steps.check: Phone list inside, bag closed, bag on you.

steps.do: Drive straight to the hub. Never stop.
steps.detail: No fuel, no food, no passenger, no errand. Nobody takes a bag home.

steps.do: Count with the hub attendant and sign.
steps.detail: Every device number goes in the hub log. Both sign and write the time in.

steps.do: Do the same at your next site.
steps.detail: One bag per site, one phone list, signatures at both ends. Thursday: every factory phone goes.

steps.do: In the morning, bring back the cleared phones.
steps.detail: Same runner, same three sites as last night. Count with the hub attendant and sign the new phone list at both ends. Held phones stay. The operator gets their device numbers.

done: Every phone reached the hub before 10 PM. Cleared phones are back and signed before 7:00 AM.

fails.then: It does not leave. Call the Planning and Logistics Lead and the Portfolio Manager now.
Count again by device number. Sign only the real count. Call the Planning and Logistics Lead now.

fails.if: Police stop you at a checkpoint
fails.then: Show letter, register copy, phone list, exact count. Never argue, never name the client. Call Moharam. Get a receipt if held.

fails.if: The vehicle is stolen or crashed
fails.then: Get safe first. Call Moharam now with the phone list count.
The Planning and Logistics Lead names the other hub before you leave. Nowhere else.

escalate: The Planning and Logistics Lead, now, any hour, for a run, a count, or the hub. Moharam, now, for police, a crash, or a theft. If anything is held, Mano brings a lawyer the same day.
